tools.description: Search published articles by title, description, tags, and shelf. [no key]

tools.name: search
tools.description: ChatGPT-compatible search. Returns results with id, title, url, and text. [no key]

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: ChatGPT-compatible fetch by id (article:, hub:, bible:, apocrypha:, or non-canonical:). A bible or Apocrypha passage for a book with a background essay includes that essay’s URL. An Apocrypha or Non-Canonical passage includes the canon note. [no key]

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Published article for a path, a slug, or a full https://apologetics.wiki URL. The default is a summary. Set full to true for the body, still capped. [no key]

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List published articles, optionally on one shelf. Shelf names are case-insensitive. Pass cursor from the previous page. An unknown shelf returns the valid shelf list. [no key]

tools.name: list_shelves
tools.description: Religions, beliefs, denominations, Islam branches, the Bible, the Apocrypha, and Non-Canonical, with hub URLs and article counts. [no key]

tools.name: get_bible_passage
tools.description: King James text for a book name or OSIS code (John, 1 John, Song of Solomon, Psalm, jhn), including the Apocrypha and Non-Canonical. tools.name: get_word_study
tools.description: Greek or Hebrew word-page data from the same indexes as /bible/greek and /bible/hebrew. Pass a slug or a Strong’s number. [no key]

tools.name: list_common_arguments
tools.description: Claims that recur in conversation: the claim, a one-line answer, the texts, and the article URL or Article coming. Filter with group and query, and page with cursor. [no key]

tools.name: get_common_argument

tools.name: get_submission_guidelines

tools.name: check_existing_coverage

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Account id, display name, role, and today’s remaining suggestion quota. [sign-in required]

tools.name: find_articles_for_claim

A single verse includes study links. include may add greek, hebrew, parallels, study_links, cross_refs, or connections. greek and hebrew return the original text, its source, and a word-by-word gloss. parallel

tools.name: get_article_summary
tools.description: Title, description, key points, and the canonical URL for one article. Pass a slug, a path, or a full https://apologetics.wiki URL. [no key]

tools.name: get_article_section
tools.description: One heading’s section from a published article, capped in length. [no key]

tools.name: related_articles
tools.description: Articles that share a shelf or a verse with a slug or a scripture reference. [no key]

tools.name: get_cross_references
tools.description: Links for a passage from every source the verse page uses, each labelled: curated links (including Jude 1:14–15 and 1 Enoch 1:9), New Testament quotations, fulfilled prophecy, allusions, the messianic prophecy list, and OpenBible.info cross-references. Connections cover the 66 books only. [no key]

tools.name: get_canon_status
tools.description: Protestant, Catholic, Orthodox, and Ethiopian status for a Bible, Apocrypha, or Non-Canonical book, with the site’s canon note. [no key]

tools.name: search_word_study
tools.description: Find Greek or Hebrew lemmas by gloss, transliteration, lemma, or Strong’s number. [no key]

tools.name: lookup_quote
tools.description: A Qur’an or hadith quotation stored on this site, with the translation name and the source URL. Nothing is returned that is not in the site’s quote list. [no key]

tools.name: get_connections_by_book
tools.description: Old Testament and New Testament connections for one King James book. Optional type is quotes, fulfilled, alludes, or see-also. Optional min_weight drops thinner chapter links and adds up what remains. One summary file. [no key]

tools.name: get_connection_graph
tools.description: Nodes and edges for the connection map. level is book or chapter. from is the Old Testament side and to is the New Testament side. testament_filter is all, ot, or nt. One graph file. [no key]

tools.name: get_messianic_prophecies
tools.description: Messianic rows from the connection files, with links to the Old Testament and New Testament verse pages. theme is a case-insensitive substring. No match returns a count of zero. One summary file. [no key]

tools.name: get_connection_stats
tools.description: Row counts, arc counts, the See Also cap, licenses, and download URLs for the connection files. One summary file. [no key]

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: The sources listed on one article, with absolute URLs. [no key]

tools.name: request_sign_in
tools.description: Get the sign-in link. This sends no email. Open the link in a browser; the page checks that you are a person and emails you a code. Then use confirm_sign_in with that code. [no key]

tools.name: confirm_sign_in
tools.description: Exchange the emailed code for a scoped API key, for a client without OAuth. Scopes are read, hearts, and suggest. The key is shown once. A client already signed in with OAuth gets a short note and no key. [no key]

tools.name: list_saved
tools.description: The signed-in account’s saved articles and Bible verses. [sign-in required]

tools.name: save_item
tools.description: Save an article path or a Bible verse path for the signed-in account. [sign-in required]

tools.name: remove_saved
tools.description: Remove one saved article or Bible verse for the signed-in account. [sign-in required]

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_article, list_shelves, get_bible_passage, list_common_arguments, get_common_argument, get_article_summary, lookup_quote, get_connection_stats, get_citations, request_sign_in · Private data: get_bible_passage, get_connections_by_book, get_connection_graph, get_messianic_prophecies, get_connection_stats, confirm_sign_in · Public sink: suggest_article_change, suggest_topic, related_articles, request_sign_in · Destructive: remove_saved.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_article, list_shelves, get_bible_passage, list_common_arguments, get_common_argument, get_article_summary, lookup_quote, get_connection_stats, get_citations, request_sign_in · Private data: get_bible_passage, get_connections_by_book, get_connection_graph, get_messianic_prophecies, get_connection_stats, confirm_sign_in · Public sink: suggest_article_change, suggest_topic, related_articles, request_sign_in · Destructive: remove_saved

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
